vertex_curvature — 3D mesh_process op

• Data kinds: mesh → curvature

• Call: import mesh_props; mesh_props.vertex_curvature(mesh) -> 'np.ndarray' (or ops3d.get("vertex_curvature"))

Usage

The mean curvature magnitude at each vertex of a triangle mesh. → (N,).
